seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Primary shares: Huffman about 56.5% and Littau about 11.4% on an NBC mid-count table; another summary put them at about 50% and 14.7%. Use the certified Statement of Vote. Huffman's birth date (Feb 18, 1964) and birthplace (Independence, Mo.) appear only in secondary sources (Wikipedia, a Voteview copy of the bioguide entry), so they are omitted from facts. The J.D. year 1990 comes from LittleSis only. The Marin water board dates come from a single secondary source. Littau: no biographical information found beyond the school board seat; the SoS filing lists a campaign site (littauforcongress.com) that was not reviewed. The school district's location was not confirmed.
